modules.live-view.name: Live view
modules.live-view.description: A live picture of each castle's troops and tools, so you can see what the bot has to work with.
modules.castle-manager.name: Castle manager
modules.castle-manager.description: Tools to look after your castles' buildings and upgrades from one page.
modules.offer-buyer.name: Offer buyer
modules.offer-buyer.description: Watches the shop for offers you pick and buys them when they appear.
modules.wheel-spin.name: Wheel spin
modules.wheel-spin.description: Spins the lucky wheel with the tickets you hold, following limits you set.
modules.overseers.name: Overseers
modules.overseers.description: Manages your overseers so their bonuses stay running.
modules.food-manager.name: Food manager
modules.food-manager.description: Keeps food and mead moving between your castles so troops are never short.
modules.messages.name: Messages
modules.messages.description: Copies your alliance chat to a Discord channel and sends what you write there back to the game.
modules.rift-raid.name: Rift raid
modules.rift-raid.description: Runs the rift raid event for you, with the army you choose for each attack.
modules.berimond.name: Berimond
modules.berimond.description: Takes part in Berimond battles on the side you pick, refilling troops and tools as it goes.
modules.towers.name: Towers
modules.towers.description: Attacks Robber Baron castles in every kingdom, with the commanders you allow. Each kingdom has its own tab.
modules.leveller.name: Leveller
modules.leveller.description: Raises an account's level by attacking a list of targets you give it, then stops when the list runs out.
modules.armourer.name: Armourer
modules.armourer.description: Buys siege tools from the armourer with coins until each one reaches the stock you set.
modules.blacksmith-event-shops.name: Blacksmith and event shops
modules.blacksmith-event-shops.descripti: Spends event currency in the shops in the order you choose, up to limits you set.
modules.nom-sam-daimyo.name: Nomads, Samurai and Daimyo
modules.nom-sam-daimyo.description: Attacks the Nomad and Samurai camps with the commanders you allow.
modules.storms.name: Storms
modules.storms.description: Attacks the Storm Islands fortresses and sends mead to your Storm Islands castle so it doesn't run out.
modules.fortress.name: Fortress
modules.fortress.description: Attacks the fortresses in Burning Sands, Everwinter Glacier and Fire Peaks with the commanders you allow. Each has its own tab.
modules.khan.name: Khan
modules.khan.description: Attacks Khan camps during the Khan event, up to the score you set.
modules.green-berimond.name: Green Berimond
modules.green-berimond.description: Attacks during the Berimond Invasion event and uses event tools to earn points.
modules.invasion-events.name: Invasion events
modules.invasion-events.description: Attacks Foreign Lords' camps and Bloodcrow camps during their events, until the event ends or your score is reached.
modules.virtual-presets.name: Virtual presets
modules.virtual-presets.description: Saves attack waves under a name, so any module can reuse them without the in-game presets.
modules.coin-farmer.name: Coin farmer
modules.coin-farmer.description: Farms coins on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.bth-blacksmith.name: BTH blacksmith
modules.bth-blacksmith.description: Works the blacksmith on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.influence-farming.name: Influence farming
modules.influence-farming.description: Collects influence on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.recruiter.name: Recruiter
modules.recruiter.description: Recruits troops for the event server's twin of your account.
modules.castle-builder.name: Castle builder
modules.castle-builder.description: Builds up the castle on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.equipment-manager.name: Equipment manager
modules.equipment-manager.description: Sorts and fits gear for the event server's twin of your account.
modules.or-storms.name: Outer realms storms
modules.or-storms.description: Attacks storm forts on the event server's twin of your account.
modules.mp-builder.name: MP builder
modules.mp-builder.description: Builds the event server's mighty place from the twin of your account.
modules.recruit-tools-heal.name: Recruit, tools and heal
modules.recruit-tools-heal.description: Trains troops, makes tools and heals the wounded on a plan you set.
modules.refinery-toolsmith.name: Refinery and toolsmith
modules.refinery-toolsmith.description: Builds siege tools in your workshops until each one reaches the stock you set.
modules.auto-feast.name: Auto-feast
modules.auto-feast.description: Starts feasts in your castles when they hold more food than you need.
modules.equip-sell.name: Equip sell
modules.equip-sell.description: Sells loose equipment and gems from your storage, a few at a time, and never relic or set pieces.
modules.daily-chores.name: Daily chores
modules.daily-chores.description: Claims the daily login bonus, sends the tax collector out, and asks your alliance for help.
modules.alert-autostation.name: Alert and autostation
modules.alert-autostation.description: When a player attacks one of your castles, moves its troops to a protected alliance castle before the attack lands.
modules.asset-monitor.name: Asset monitor
modules.asset-monitor.description: Keeps watch on the castles of other players and tells you when something changes.
modules.discord-attacks.name: Discord attack alerts
modules.discord-attacks.description: Posts attacks on you and your own attacks to Discord channels.
modules.discord-events.name: Discord event alerts
